United by the efforts of War Champion Melantha, the divine champions of Terra-Nova unite at Castle Ikaris, holding the second champions convergence. They make a pact to join in the war of Two Crowns, and to work together towards the goal of defeating Ivar and his wicked patron, Arkonil the God Killer. Alongside Augustus Auranthor, suspected hero of prophecy and Lightbearer, they lead their armies across the continent to begin the war efort.
